				if = { limit = { country_exists = ALB } ALB = { IMP_sanctions_add_mil_from_prev = yes } }
				if = { limit = { country_exists = CHI } CHI = { IMP_sanctions_add_mil_from_prev = yes } }
				if = { limit = { country_exists = MON } MON = { IMP_sanctions_add_mil_from_prev = yes } }
				if = { limit = { country_exists = NKO } NKO = { IMP_sanctions_add_mil_from_prev = yes } }
				if = { limit = { country_exists = VIE } VIE = { IMP_sanctions_add_mil_from_prev = yes } }
			}
		}

		# australian_china_controls: Australian strategic China controls alongside substantial non-strategic trade; Australia was not yet a CoCom member.
		# Source: https://www.dfat.gov.au/about-us/publications/historical-documents/volume-22/Pages/156-letter-from-mcmahon-to-gorton
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = AST }
			AST = {
				if = { limit = { country_exists = CHI } CHI = { IMP_sanctions_add_mil_from_prev = yes } }
			}
		}

		# arab_primary_boycott: Arab League primary boycott of Israeli trade and financial transactions. Not the later 1973 oil embargo; no automatic reciprocal Israeli sanctions or sanctions on third countries.
		# Source: https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1961-63v17/d314
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = EGY }
			EGY = {
				if = { limit = { country_exists = ISR } ISR = { IMP_sanctions_add_fin_from_prev = yes IMP_sanctions_add_eco_from_prev = yes } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = IRQ }
			IRQ = {
				if = { limit = { country_exists = ISR } ISR = { IMP_sanctions_add_fin_from_prev = yes IMP_sanctions_add_eco_from_prev = yes } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = JOR }
			JOR = {
				if = { limit = { country_exists = ISR } ISR = { IMP_sanctions_add_fin_from_prev = yes IMP_sanctions_add_eco_from_prev = yes } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = LEB }

				if = { limit = { country_exists = ISR } ISR = { IMP_sanctions_add_fin_from_prev = yes IMP_sanctions_add_eco_from_prev = yes } }

		if = {

			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = SYR }
			SYR = {
				if = { limit = { country_exists = ISR } ISR = { IMP_sanctions_add_fin_from_prev = yes IMP_sanctions_add_eco_from_prev = yes } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = YEM }
			YEM = {
				if = { limit = { country_exists = ISR } ISR = { IMP_sanctions_add_fin_from_prev = yes IMP_sanctions_add_eco_from_prev = yes } }

		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = SYE }
			SYE = {
				if = { limit = { country_exists = ISR } ISR = { IMP_sanctions_add_fin_from_prev = yes IMP_sanctions_add_eco_from_prev = yes } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = LBA }
			LBA = {
				if = { limit = { country_exists = ISR } ISR = { IMP_sanctions_add_fin_from_prev = yes IMP_sanctions_add_eco_from_prev = yes } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = SUD }
			SUD = {
				if = { limit = { country_exists = ISR } ISR = { IMP_sanctions_add_fin_from_prev = yes IMP_sanctions_add_eco_from_prev = yes } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = MOR }
			MOR = {

		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = TUN }
			TUN = {
				if = { limit = { country_exists = ISR } ISR = { IMP_sanctions_add_fin_from_prev = yes IMP_sanctions_add_eco_from_prev = yes } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = KUW }
			KUW = {

				if = { limit = { country_exists = ISR } ISR = { IMP_sanctions_add_fin_from_prev = yes IMP_sanctions_add_eco_from_prev = yes } }
			}
		}

		# french_israel_arms: French weapons embargo tightened in January 1969; commercial trade is not embargoed.
		# Source: https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1969-76v23/d8
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = FRA }
			FRA = {
				if = { limit = { country_exists = ISR } ISR = { IMP_sanctions_add_mil_from_prev = yes } }
			}
		}

		# south_africa_arms: Implemented US/UK arms restrictions before 1970. The 1963 UN appeal was voluntary; France remained an arms supplier. No worldwide 1977 embargo is projected backwards.
		# Source: https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1969-76v28/d17
		# Source: https://hansard.parliament.uk/Commons/1970-04-29/debates/9e40ff24-ffc8-4298-b5ae-6102d7c3c925/SouthAfrica%28Trade%29
		# Source: https://hansard.parliament.uk/Commons/1969-07-21/debates/8a481499-5e45-47b2-908b-cb1b088f780c/OrdersOfTheDay
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = USA }
			USA = {
				if = { limit = { country_exists = SAF } SAF = { IMP_sanctions_add_mil_from_prev = yes } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = ENG }
			ENG = {
				if = { limit = { country_exists = SAF } SAF = { IMP_sanctions_add_mil_from_prev = yes } }
			}
		}

		# indian_south_africa_boycott: India's trade boycott began in 1946, followed by diplomatic/commercial/cultural/sporting isolation. No separate comprehensive financial freeze is inferred.
		# Source: https://meacms.mea.gov.in/Portal/ForeignRelation/Bilateral-brief_SA-for-XPD-June-2024.pdf
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = RAJ }
			RAJ = {
				if = { limit = { country_exists = SAF } SAF = { IMP_sanctions_add_dip_from_prev = yes IMP_sanctions_add_eco_from_prev = yes IMP_sanctions_add_mil_from_prev = yes } }
			}
		}

		# us_south_asia_arms: Continuing restriction on lethal end-items after 1965; non-lethal items/spares permitted since 1966/67. Not an economic embargo or the later 1971 suspension.
		# Source: https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1969-76ve07/d42
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = USA }
			USA = {
				if = { limit = { country_exists = RAJ } RAJ = { IMP_sanctions_add_mil_from_prev = yes } }
				if = { limit = { country_exists = PAK } PAK = { IMP_sanctions_add_mil_from_prev = yes } }
			}
		}
	}

	IMP_1970_seed_historical_sanctions_only = yes
	IMP_sanctions_refresh_world = yes
